title: Run Workflow: boot the orchestrator sandbox and own the run lifecycle
description: The Cloudflare Workflow that makes a run survive everything below it. Steps: acquire context, boot ONE orchestrator sandbox from the Phase 1 image, watch it, enforce wall-clock and cost budgets, finalize (release the lease, write the runs row, stream remaining artifacts). Durable execution means the supervisor cannot be lost; the sandbox is expected to die and a fresh one is booted whose first instruction is the reconcile protocol. Budget enforcement lives HERE, never in a prompt: exhaustion is a clean stop (finish in-flight, then review and closeout), identical to the operator stop path. Harness output streams to R2 under runs/project/run_id during the run, never export-at-exit, so a crashed run leaves its logs behind.
